propositions: The outbound differ currently compares fields in vendor (Jira) shape while the inbound differ compares in canonical (local) shape, violating the core-adapter seam principle that vendor shapes must not be readable in core.

The outbound differ must be refactored to canonicalize the snapshot via the injected InboundMapper, perform all field comparisons in local names/values, and emit vendor payloads only via a new OutboundMapper.map_fields_to_remote() method at the emission boundary.

The InboundMapper output must be widened with three new canonical alias keys—assignee_identity (dict with display/email/account_id), remote_parent_id (string), and reporter_identity (dict)—to replace vendor-specific helpers like _assignee_matches and enable neutral comparison logic.

The stored baseline remains vendor-shaped at rest (no migration); the arbitration path applies map_remote_to_local to the baseline entry at read time, and the mapper must tolerate partial _BASELINE_FIELDS subsets by emitting only canonical keys whose vendor source is present.

The assignee resolver and _assignee_is_account_id sentinel must be re-homed to OutboundMapper.resolve_assignee(), parameterized only on the canonical assignee_identity shape, preserving the 3-state contract (payload_value, authoritative, is_account_id) for downstream dispatch.

All vendor-specific comparison helpers (_diff_fields, _extract_jira_field, _assignee_matches, _LOCAL_TO_JIRA_TYPE) must become adapter-internal; outbound_differ.py must contain no adapters.jira imports and no raw Jira snapshot key literals (accountId, emailAddress, issuetype, etc).
